title: BC Gov News, Ministry of Finance
what: Finance news releases by date; budget PST measures (e.g. professional services) are announced here first.

title: BC PST publications (bulletins and notices)
what: Index of PST bulletins and numbered notices (e.g. Notice 2026-001 on professional services, 2023-005 cloud software); new and revised items change BC rules.

title: BC updates to sales taxes
what: Dated list of PST changes from budgets and legislation, with effective dates.

title: CDTFA industry and tax and fee guides
what: Index of industry guides (restaurants, digital products, construction, software); new or revised guides restate taxability.

title: CDTFA special notices and notification letters
what: Dated special notices (e.g. L-1036, digital products taxable from 2027-01-01, cited by the SaaS rule); the main signal for California law changes.

title: CDTFA status of proposed rules and regulations
what: Regulations in progress (e.g. 1502, 1503, 1521, 1603, 1628 cited by the rules), with hearing and approval dates.

title: CDTFA tax information bulletins
what: Quarterly Tax Information Bulletins with articles on new law, regulation changes and taxability clarifications.

title: CRA Excise and GST/HST News
what: Periodic newsletter by year announcing new and revised GST/HST publications and legislative changes.

title: CRA GST/HST info sheets
what: Info sheets (GI-series), including GI-064 Ontario prepared-food rebate and GI-202 platform delivery cited by the rules.

title: CRA GST/HST notices
what: Numbered GST/HST notices, newest first; rate changes, transitional rules and new measures for GST and every HST province.

title: CRA GST/HST technical information bulletins
what: Technical information bulletins (B-series), including B-090 on e-commerce cited by the SaaS rules.

title: CRA provincial point-of-sale rebate eligibility (reason code 16)
what: Lists each HST province's point-of-sale rebate items (ON, NS, NB, NL, PE); the rules for all five cite it.

title: Manitoba tax publications list (CSV)
what: Data behind the Manitoba Tax Publications page: every RST bulletin and notice with its release date. Ignore the daydiff and New columns, which change daily.

title: Manitoba taxation homepage
what: Links the current budget bulletin and RST notices; changes when a new budget bulletin is published.

title: Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick bills
what: Current-session bills with status; NB has no HST notice index, so enacted tax bills show here.

title: New Brunswick budget
what: Budget landing page with the year's budget documents; HST rate or rebate changes are announced here.

title: New Brunswick Finance taxes page
what: Finance's tax index with HST notices (rate-change transitional rules, rebates) and other tax notices.

title: House of Assembly progress of bills, 51st GA 1st session
what: Progress of bills in the current session; NL has no HST notice index. Update the URL when a new session opens (index: /HouseBusiness/Bills/).

title: Newfoundland and Labrador budget
what: Budget landing page; HST rebates and rate changes are announced in the budget.

title: Newfoundland and Labrador Finance HST page
what: Finance's HST page with provincial measures (point-of-sale book rebate, rate transitional rules).

title: Nova Scotia budget
what: Current budget home; HST rate and rebate measures appear in the budget documents.

title: Nova Scotia budget documents
what: Budget publications by year, including tax measures and forecast updates.

title: Nova Scotia Finance and Treasury Board news releases
what: Department news filtered to Finance and Treasury Board; HST rate changes and new provincial rebates are announced here.

title: NY DTF important notices (N-Notices)
what: Dated N-Notices across taxes, including sales tax law changes and new exemptions.

title: NY DTF sales tax advisory opinions (TSB-A)
what: Sales tax advisory opinions by year; opinions on software, SaaS, information services and food are the evidence behind several NY rules.

title: NY DTF sales tax publications and tax bulletins
what: Index of sales tax publications (Pub 750, Pub 718-A) and TB-ST bulletins; a new or revised bulletin can change food, prepared food, software or services treatment.

title: NY DTF sales tax technical memoranda (TSB-M)
what: Sales tax TSB-Ms by year: the department's statements of changes in law, regulations or policy.

title: Legislative Assembly of Ontario current bills
what: Current-session bills with status; budget measures acts carry HST rebate changes (no Ministry notices page exists).

title: Ontario budget
what: Redirects to the current year's Ontario budget; new HST rebates or exemptions are announced here.

title: Ontario Harmonized Sales Tax guide
what: Ministry of Finance HST guide and its chapters; Ontario has no notice index, so this is where provincial HST changes appear.

title: Ontario HST point-of-sale rebates
what: Ontario's own list of HST point-of-sale rebates (prepared food under $4 and others), cited by the ON rules; changes when a rebate is added or ended.

title: Assemblée nationale du Québec bills by session
what: Session list for bills; Revenu Québec and Finances Québec block automated fetches, so this is the reachable signal. A new session (44th Legislature after the October 2026 election) appears here; its bills page is projets-loi-44-1.html.

title: Saskatchewan budget
what: Current budget; PST base expansions and exemptions are budget measures.

title: Saskatchewan provincial sales tax
what: PST landing page; announcements of PST base changes are posted here.

title: Saskatchewan PST bulletins and information notices
what: SETS index of PST bulletins (PST.007, .033, .046, .065 cited by the rules) and information notices (IN 20xx-nn). Server sends an incomplete TLS chain; the fetcher must supply the intermediate certificate.

title: Streamlined Sales Tax taxability matrix, Washington versions
what: JSON list of Washington's published SST Taxability Matrix (Library of Definitions) versions behind the sst.streamlinedsalestax.org/TM app; a new version means WA restated food, prepared food, software or other product taxability.

title: WA DOR interim guidance statements
what: Current and canceled interim guidance (the ESSB 5814 custom software, IT services and advertising statements cited by the rules); a new or canceled statement changes taxability before a rule is adopted.

title: WA DOR rule and tax advisory adoptions and repeals
what: Dated list of adopted, amended and repealed WAC 458-20 rules and ETAs; the rules cite WAC 458-20-119, -15502, -15503, -170 and -244.

title: WA DOR special notices
what: Dated special notices on law changes (e.g. ESSB 5814 services newly taxed); a new notice can move SaaS, IT, custom software, construction or delivery rules.

title: WA DOR summary of tax legislation by session
what: DOR's per-session summaries of enacted tax bills; a new session's summary lists changes to retail sales tax definitions and exemptions.

title: WA DOR what's new
what: Running list of new DOR guidance, law changes and publications by date.
